headline: ARAFURA VOTE PASSES 99.52% — A$350M NOLANS PACKAGE UNLOCKED; AUSTRALIA'S FIRST INTEGRATED RARE EARTH MINE CLEARED FOR CONSTRUCTION (ASX:ARU)
snippet: Arafura Rare Earths Ltd. (ASX:ARU) confirmed July 2, 2026 that every resolution at its Extraordinary General Meeting was carried by poll, with the KfW share issuance resolution passing at 99.52% in favour — clearing the final procedural obstacle to the A$350 million funding package from Export Finance Australia, Germany's KfW development bank, and the National Reconstruction Fund. Approval unlocks the multi-government-backed financing that advances Nolans toward becoming Australia's first fully integrated rare earth mine and a critical Western supply-chain source for NdPr magnets used in EV motors and defence systems, directly countering China's ongoing rare earth export control regime.

headline: POWER METALLIC LION ZONE HITS 13.3m AT 3.98% CuEq AND 5.26m AT 8.45% CuEq — MAIDEN MRE AND PEA BOTH DUE END OF JULY (TSXV:PNPN)
snippet: Power Metallic Mines Inc. (TSXV:PNPN, OTCQB:PNPNF) released July 2 additional infill drill intercepts from the high-grade polymetallic Lion Zone, with hole PML-26-115 returning 13.30 metres at 3.98% copper equivalent (recoverable) and hole PML-26-105 cutting 5.26 metres at 8.45% CuEq — among the final assays to be incorporated into a maiden NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate for Lion targeted for completion by end of July 2026, immediately followed by a Preliminary Economic Assessment. The Lion Zone hosts copper, nickel, cobalt, and platinum-group metals; the previous best hole returned 22 metres at 11.46% CuEq including 6.5 metres at 18.59%, and the deposit style is amenable to potential open-pit development.

headline: FREEGOLD'S 17.2MOZ ALASKA GIANT DRILLS 2.08 g/t AU OVER 62.1m AT DEPTH — 6 RIGS RUNNING AS 50,000m PROGRAM HITS HALFWAY (TSX:FVL)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Freegold Ventures Limited (TSX:FVL)
snippet: Freegold Ventures Limited (TSX:FVL) reported July 2 infill results from its 50,000-metre 2026 drill program at Golden Summit in Alaska's Fairbanks Mining District, with highlight hole GS2607 returning 2.08 g/t gold over 62.1 metres (within 102.3 metres at 1.67 g/t) from 371.9 metres depth, including bonanza sub-intervals of 1.4 metres at 16.72 g/t and 2.6 metres at 10.16 g/t. Six rigs are operating with over 25,000 metres of the planned 50,000-metre program complete; the resource stands at 17.2 million oz Indicated (1.24 g/t Au) and 11.9 million oz Inferred, positioning Golden Summit as one of North America's largest undeveloped primary gold deposits ahead of a Pre-Feasibility Study targeted for 2027.

headline: GRC SHAREHOLDERS VOTE TODAY ON GOLDGROUP MERGER — 3 MEXICAN GOLD MINES COMBINE; ERIC SPROTT BACKING YES
snippet: Gold Resource Corporation (NYSE:GORO) is holding a special shareholder meeting today, July 2, to vote on its proposed merger with Goldgroup Mining Inc. — a transaction that would combine GRC's Don David Gold Mine in Oaxaca with Goldgroup's San Francisco and Cerro Prieto mines in Sonora, Mexico, creating a larger Mexico-focused precious metals producer. GRC shareholders receive 1.4476 Goldgroup shares per share; notable investor Eric Sprott has filed a voting and support agreement backing the deal, and GRC's board of directors recommends shareholders vote in favour. The combination requires a simple majority of outstanding shares to pass.

headline: PLATINUM SURGES 5% INTRADAY, TESTS $1,642 BREAKOUT — DOLLAR BREAKS KEY SUPPORT; ANALYSTS CALL METALS WINDOW OPEN FOR JULY
snippet: Technical analyst Anna Radomska's July 2, 2026 outlook examines whether platinum can hold a 5%-plus intraday surge following the June payrolls miss, or whether thin pre-holiday liquidity will reverse the move as a fakeout — with the U.S. Dollar Index closing below critical support near 100.96 representing the most significant macro signal. Platinum at $1,642 must confirm above key resistance levels to validate a structural recovery rather than a short-squeeze; palladium has reclaimed the 61.8% Fibonacci retracement on the monthly chart, keeping the 1,125 support zone protected and leaving room for further PGM gains if the dollar continues weakening into Q3.

headline: SILVER'S SIXTH CONSECUTIVE SUPPLY DEFICIT ARRIVES — 46.3MOZ SHORTFALL PROJECTED AS MINE SUPPLY CANNOT KEEP PACE THIS DECADE
snippet: A July 2, 2026 InvestorIdeas analysis highlights that Metals Focus and the Silver Institute project a 2026 silver market deficit of 46.3 million ounces — the sixth consecutive annual shortfall — with no material new mine supply coming online this decade capable of closing the gap as industrial demand from solar panels, EVs, and AI data centres accelerates. The piece examines the Sinda Ltd. $213 million NYSE IPO — backed by a $110 million private placement from Fresnillo, the world's largest primary silver miner — as evidence that major institutional capital is now positioning for long-dated silver supply scarcity by funding future ounces in the ground.

headline: COPPER HOLDS 605 KEY SUPPORT ON JUNE MONTHLY CLOSE — PALLADIUM RECLAIMS 61.8% FIB AS METALS SETUP TURNS CONSTRUCTIVE
snippet: In a July 2, 2026 monthly-close review, technical analyst Anna Radomska notes that copper's June 30 close above the 605 level — former resistance converted to key support — maintains the upside structure toward 641 and 671.60, a constructive setup heading into H2 as Section 232 copper tariff uncertainty tightens refined supply. Palladium's reclamation of the 61.8% Fibonacci retracement on the monthly chart preserves the 1,125 support zone; Radomska argues the bigger picture for base and precious metals has shifted decisively constructive on the June monthly close, regardless of short-term payrolls-driven volatility.

headline: KUTCHO COPPER MOBILIZES 2 RIGS FOR NW BRITISH COLUMBIA HIGH-GRADE CU-ZN PUSH — 11 HOLES TARGET RESOURCE DOUBLING (TSXV:KC)
snippet: Kutcho Copper Corp. (TSXV:KC, OTCQX:KCCFF) announced July 2 that mobilization is underway for its 2026 exploration program at the feasibility-stage, high-grade copper-zinc development project in Northwest British Columbia, with two drill rigs scheduled to commence drilling in mid-July. The 11-hole program targets near-resource zones Hamburger, Gap, and Esso West — all accompanied by down-hole EM surveys — with the stated goal of potentially doubling the existing resource base and extending mine life ahead of a construction decision on a project with feasibility-level engineering already in hand.

headline: BLACK HORSE FIRES DIAMOND RIG AT MT EGERTON GOLD — 500m DEEP HOLES TARGET UNTESTED STRUCTURES IN WA GREENSTONE BELT (ASX:BHL)
source_name: Discovery Alert / Black Horse Mining Ltd. (ASX:BHL)
snippet: Black Horse Mining Ltd. (ASX:BHL) confirmed via July 2, 2026 ASX announcement that a high-capacity diamond drilling rig is now operating at the Mt Egerton Gold Project in Western Australia, with shallower initial holes transitioning to deeper targets of approximately 500 metres designed to test structures not previously drill-tested at depth. Mt Egerton sits within the Norseman-Wiluna Greenstone Belt — one of Australia's most prolific gold-bearing geological corridors — and the 500-metre program depth is intended to test extensions of known surface gold mineralisation beneath the oxidised zone and into fresh rock.
